title: REQ · After a 401 and re-entry, AdminApp shows no stale round or execution data
summary: The 401 branch also clears the loaded round, execution and contributions.
description: After the gate returns, a re-entered token must show the Loading round state rather than the previous round, execution and contribution list, so stale Approve, Retry or Reject buttons cannot appear.
acceptance_criteria: Given a 401 from an execution action, when the gate is shown, then no Round or Execution content is rendered.
Given the token is re-entered, when data reloads, then the loaded round and execution come from the new responses.

preserve: Existing reload flow via reloads counter

technical_constraints: Reset state with the existing setters setRound, setExecution and setContributions
definition_of_done: 401 branch resets round, execution and contributions
